cards.title: canvas
cards.text:
A React Flow canvas as a tab template, and the default canvas. What is decided for it here (how it is drawn, how it opens, how positions and filters are kept) applies to every tab that draws a graph. The other canvases (the ERD, the component map, the architecture diagram, the delta) are adapted to it so they all behave the same. It is explored in its own exploration, "exploration canvas", created with the v2 architecture.

Standards: to be set in that exploration. There is no good reference yet, so none is linked.

cards.title: FLEXIBLE tab → tab as UI as data
cards.text:
A tab whose content is a UI as data document. The exploration describes the tab as a document (layout, stacks, tables, lists, a canvas, whatever it needs), gets its data through the exploration's data API, and one generic renderer draws it. It gives an exploration full freedom: any tab can be made without new code, and the tabs of the templates are special cases of it. Possible name: open tab.

The global elements (see the card "GLOBAL ELEMENTS (NOT A TAB)": a mention of any entity of the exploration, shown as a badge with a hover preview and a click that opens a modal) and the rich UI tables and lists are available inside these documents.

cards.title: canvas standards
cards.text: The standards the old canvas v2 already had, to carry into the exploration canvas. Toolbox on the left: select (V), pan (H), rectangle (R), group (G), text (T), note (N), document (K). Every node has a handle on each side plus one at the center. A connection dropped on the center handle is a floating edge: it runs center to center and leaves from the border facing the other node. A connection dropped on a side handle is fixed to that side. Loose connection mode, so any handle connects to any handle. Dragging the end of an edge reconnects it; double click on an edge edits its label. Dropping a node into a group adopts it, dragging it out releases it. Pan only in pan mode, box selection in select mode. Resizer on rectangle, text and group. Minimap, zoom controls, background. To add from the new brief: dark mode follows the theme, click a node highlights it and its direct connections, positions saved as in the ERD, trackpad pan and pinch zoom, multi-select and drag, drawing shapes.

cards.title: component builder
cards.text: A tab type to build a component while playing with it, from the old Component Cockpit. You pick the component. Its props are read from its TypeScript and become controls: a switch for a boolean, a select for a union of strings, a field for a string or a number, sizes included. The component renders live next to the controls. A permutation list shows every combination of the union and boolean props, each with its applied props on hover. Fixtures feed the component: a sample fixture that ships with it, plus fixtures you add and name, and a data source to load a real entity by id from the data API. Panels: config, data source, code, readme. In the old cockpit an entry went candidate, component, pattern, ready, with status draft, approved or deprecated. Here the fixtures would be saved in the exploration's state, and the same component would show under global previewers.

cards.title: live play player
cards.text: One component that shows a ui_live_play by its id, composing the play's parts (header, cast, stage, transport with the step list) in a layout: player (the stage with the commands over it, on hover), panel (the stage and the step list beside), full (header and cast across the top). The parts share one store per play: one request, one position. The simplest instance is the stage with the commands over it.
